title: Groups
purpose: Inspect role groups and the disposal approval permission they grant.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: The administration site requires an active account with Staff status. User and group pages additionally require Superuser status; an admin role alone or individual model permissions do not open them. These technical flags do not themselves confer operational roles or disposal approval authority.

sections.title: Columns and controls
paragraphs: Search matches case-insensitive substrings. Space-separated terms must each match at least one configured field; quote a phrase to match it as one term. The result query includes all matches, not just visible rows. Clearing the search restores the unsearched set while preserving applicable filters.

These are Django administration tables, not operational grids. The server uses 100 records per page, with numbered page links and a total count. Show all appears when the filtered result count is at most 200 and exceeds one page. There is no Rows per page selector or Columns dialog. Linked sortable headings change order; repeated heading clicks change direction or remove that ordering. The sidebar navigation filter only filters module links, not table records.
Initial order is Name ascending. Name and Members are sortable; Grants disposal approval is not. There are no sidebar filters, row checkboxes or bulk actions.

items.label: Name
items.description: Unique group identity; opens group permissions.

items.label: Members
items.description: Count of assigned users, including inactive members. It is not a member editing control.

items.label: Grants disposal approval
items.description: True only when the group has accounts approve_disposal. Members still need active accounts to exercise that permission.

items.label: Add group
items.description: Creates a permission group. Arbitrary new names do not become built-in roles.

sections.title: Preservation
paragraphs: Built-in admin, manager, technician and viewer names are read only when editing existing groups. Other groups can be renamed. Deletion is disabled for all groups, and permission/name changes are audited.
